stages.behavior: Receive period/evidence/source/policy/review events. A native recognizer observation is only an impact-assessment request; it cannot assert a verified accounting change.
Resolve entity/period applicability; inspect asset heads, typed facts, authentic evidence, source passages and current upstream versions. Create owned tasks; route cross-family contributions.
Create or update an explicitly labelled draft using supplied typed inputs, preserving unresolved fields and prior immutable revisions.
Check document amounts, movement schedules, totals, note cross-references and upstream lineage. Missing or contradictory evidence remains visible and assigned.
Submit the exact revision to its independent named reviewer; enforce source/index/evidence checks and immutable content hash. The drafting agent cannot approve.
Reassess on events and fingerprint drift, invalidate dependent approvals, supersede obsolete tasks and rebuild/review affected revisions.

documentOwnership: Exactly one accountable family per asset type; entity/period/type identifies a canonical document head. Specialized machines contribute their scope, not competing master versions.

channels.nativePE: Existing advise-only analyst binding, numeric completion format and mapping preserved.
channels.documents: Separate structured documentWorkflowBinding and task/artifact sidecar; runtime tool authorization must enforce owned-versus-request-only types.

productionIntegrationRequired: Install candidate agent schema and make document catalog/templates/readable control references available to the agents
Bind local or enterprise entity/period/fact/source/policy/index snapshots and authentic evidence connectors
Route native observations through validated observe_machine rather than treating token branches as completed accounting facts
Dispatch owned outbox tasks to the corresponding family with create/revise/contribute permissions
Enforce documentWorkflowBinding permissions at the tool gateway; library functions are trusted internal operations, not an authentication service
Connect passage-preserving RAG and calculation/reconciliation executors; model confidence and citations alone are insufficient
Route review requests to the assigned independent name string and persist authentic review decisions at the connector boundary
Verify connected accounting and native three-engine behavior before corpus acceptance
